summary: Append content to one markdown file.

input_schema.file_path: string | The full path of the file to append to.
input_schema.content: string | The content to append to the file.
input_schema.if_revision: string | optional | Only append to the file if its current revision matches this value.
input_schema.force: boolean | optional | Force the append, ignoring revision conflicts. Defaults to false.

output_schema.path: string | The full path of the file.
output_schema.content: string | The content of the file.
output_schema.size_bytes: integer | The size of the file in bytes.
output_schema.created_at: date-time|null|optional | The timestamp when the file was created.
output_schema.updated_at: date-time|null|optional | The timestamp when the file was last updated.
output_schema.revision: string | The revision identifier for the file.
